name: Briarmane Ranger Saddle
description: A long-ride forest saddle shaped specifically to the Briarmane Courser's tall, lean build — built on a layered Silverbark Ash frame with treated stag-hide and Thornfiber lash points. Lighter and quieter in brush than a realm saddle, with a deeper thigh contact and slightly forward seat that suits the Briarmane's gait and accommodates the breed's habit of pausing at wardlines without unsettling the rider.
narrative_effects: Required equipment for sustained mounted travel without imposing fatigue penalties.
Quieter and lower-snag than a realm saddle in dense forest terrain; supports stealthed-approach narration when mounted.
Specifically fitted to Briarmane Coursers and similar long-legged forest mounts; less optimal on heavier or shorter-bodied breeds.
Standard issue for Greenshield rangers and the elven scout traditions of Thornveil and Vaelmere.
